change: Skip comparing an image view with itself in the renderer upload-difference check.

profileEvidence.scope: Per-image target callback includes byte comparison and upload command creation; not all of this cost is attributed to self-comparison.

reason: Decoded texture-cache hits return the same host byte image. A bytewise comparison of a view with itself always finds equality. Fresh guest-memory reads and changed cached textures still produce separate images and use the existing exact-byte comparison.

microbenchmark.scope: Exact same decoded image object repeated; CPU microbenchmark, not guest FPS. Distinct image copies still compare bytes.

validation: Complete actual Chrome WebGPU regression passed, including unchanged upload reuse, CPU texture/attachment modifications and changed mip/face/row uploads.
Small and non-DWORD-aligned byte lengths: old/new changed boundaries agree for front/middle/tail changes.
limits: No DMA/source-byte validation removed from the decoded texture cache.
No page dirtiness assumptions or guest clock/timeout changes.
Microbenchmark removes only an exact self-scan; no native FPS or driver-timeout claim.
